set_speed(speed: 250.0, acceleration: 1.4)

# Define safety zones

    return [
        [-0.3, 0.3, -0.3, 0.3],  # X, Y, Z, R
        [-0.3, 0.3, -0.3, 0.3]

    ]

    [0.2, 0.0, 0.5, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0],  # Above storage bin

    # Add more waypoints as needed
]

# Safety check and motion execution
def execute_motion():
    for i in range(len(waypoints)):

        movej(waypoints[i], speed: 250.0, acceleration: 1.4)

# Execute the motion sequence
execute_motion()
